rationale: These terms stay literal per D-02 (brand names, platform names and units are pinned do-not-translate); D-21 extended the list after measuring compound and variant brand forms (Amazon, ZOOM, Zoom, Epic/Legendary, Amazon/Nile, Amazon Games) in ConsoleMode/index.tsx, LogSettings/index.tsx and StoreSearch/helpers.ts. The gate failing on an unglossed brand name is the intended reminder to extend this file when a new store is added.
